primary: The promoted candidate under the existing median +0.001, worst loss <=0.002, and latency gate; no reduced or seal selection.
backup_robust: Among other completed candidates with mean >= primary mean -0.005 and median >= primary median -0.005, maximize worst-fold TS-AUC, then minimize fold standard deviation.
backup_fast: Among other completed candidates with mean >= primary mean -0.010 and worst >= primary worst -0.010, shortlist at most five by existing native latency. Select lowest measured isolated production latency; report the score sacrifice explicitly.
eligibility: All five frozen folds complete, deterministic serialized predictor, deployable supported contract; no partial-fold selection.
selection_uncertainty: Adaptive DEV selection among many candidates; group bootstrap is conditional on selected OOF predictions and does not correct selection bias.
fallback: If a distinct robust or fast candidate does not qualify, record none instead of inventing a backup.

latency_evidence_clarification.meaning: Use the best numerically verified production path for each candidate when shortlisting fast backups, including compact/fused XGBoost. Existing score gates and score tolerance thresholds are unchanged.
